temporal_domain.inheritance: exact retained 33-graph subset; no event detection, resplit, or sample-origin change

tensor_schema.obs_node_index: int64 [Nobs], station observation mapping; duplicates allowed
tensor_schema.q_target: float32 [S,Nobs,6], raw Q m3/s, NaN iff mask=false
tensor_schema.z_target: float32 [S,Nobs,6], delta Z from t0 in m, NaN iff mask=false

rain_zero_semantics: within frozen global timeline, absent positive sparse record is 0 mm
observation_semantics: Q/Z exist only on Nobs mapped stations; no computational-node broadcasting or zero filling
